21.recommendation: Restrict FTP access and prefer SFTP or FTPS.

22.recommendation: Use SSH keys, disable password authentication where possible, and restrict administrative access.

23.recommendation: Disable Telnet and replace it with SSH.

25.recommendation: Prevent open relay and enforce TLS.

80.description: HTTP service exposed without transport encryption.

110.recommendation: Use POP3S or another encrypted mail protocol.

443.recommendation: Maintain a valid TLS configuration and keep certificates and cryptographic libraries updated.

445.recommendation: Disable SMBv1 and restrict SMB access.

3389.recommendation: Restrict RDP using firewall rules, VPN and MFA.

3306.recommendation: Restrict database access to trusted hosts and networks.

5432.recommendation: Restrict PostgreSQL access to trusted hosts and networks.

135.recommendation: Restrict RPC port 135 access using host firewalls or network segmentation.

139.recommendation: Disable NetBIOS over TCP/IP if not required and block port 139.

5900.recommendation: Restrict VNC access and use encrypted tunnels or VPN.

8000.description: HTTP web application service exposed on port 8000.
8000.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS encryption and restrict administrative web interface access.

8080.description: HTTP web proxy/service exposed on port 8080.
8080.recommendation: Enforce authentication, HTTPS transport encryption, and access controls.
